cds.title: The University of Alabama Common Data Set 2025-26 (PDF, Office of Institutional Research and Assessment)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1, table headed 'Caution: 2025-26' (the CDS says final 2026-27 costs are published July 1): in-state tuition $11,684, out-of-state and nonresident tuition $34,542, required fees $800, on-campus food and housing $13,616 (housing $9,000 + meals $4,616). Estimated expenses (residents): books $700, transportation $2,266, other $3,962 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour: $545 in-state, $1,520 out-of-state. H: institutional non-need-based aid is available to undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents (need-based is not ticked); 213 nonresidents received institutional aid, average $33,933 (the CDS does not split need and non-need). The 2026-27 funding figure international students must show for an I-20 is on the cycle page.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 61,994 applied, 44,124 admitted (71.2%), 8,127 enrolled. This CDS has no in-state / out-of-state / international rows for C1, so those counts are left empty; B2 shows 91 nonresident (international) degree-seeking first-time first-years enrolled. C2: no waiting list. No early decision or early action (C21/C22 both 'No'); rolling admission with a priority date. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (the 'submitted scores' column is 49% at 4.0, the 'did not submit' column 17%). Undergraduate enrollment (35,621) and the nonresident count (382) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures; degree-seeking only: 33,989 and 328. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-years who submitted scores (19% SAT, 53% ACT).
